thread:
Mira K: Quick heads-up - started onboarding Tidepool's LoRA into rwd/base-v2 and ran a tiny quickpack with q4_0. Seeing an odd tokenization split on numeric invoice fields after merge+quant.
Chen Li: can you paste the exact command and the short results?
Mira K: ran: `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --model rwd/base-v2 --adapter tidepool-lora.safetensors --quant q4_0 --batch 16 --seed 42`
Mira K: short metrics: EM 0.78 -> 0.62, F1 0.81 -> 0.66. Token diffs: avg_token_shift=0.03, unk_token_rate up from 0.2% -> 1.8%. Example: "Invoice 245" -> "Invoice 24 5" (space inserted).
Alex S: hmm, tokenizer hashes match? sometimes merges change activation scaling and that interacts with int4 quantization causing logits to cross tokenizer boundaries.
Mira K: ran tokenizer hash and vocab compare - identical. But when running inference the digit-segmentation token appears ~1.8% of the time on the testpack.
Chen Li: try merging with a lower adapter alpha (0.5) and use postnorm merge-order; also try merging first, then quantizing, vs quantizing components separately. Order changes numeric kernels.
Mira K: re-ran with `alpha=0.5` + `--merge-order=postnorm` then quantized. EM improved to 0.73 and unk spikes dropped to ~0.4%. Not fully fixed but much better.
Alex S: good. Add a targeted remap for digit tokens if tails persist. Also capture failing inputs into a failset for the regression alert.
Chen Li: infra-bot: please provision a short dedicated run (2xA10) for a 2k sample smokepack so we can check the long tail.
infra-bot: scheduled run 7870012377 on dedicated-qa-a10-2 (ETA ~5m). Logs will be in /runs/7870012377/. I will post results back here when finished. :gear:
Mira K: saved failing examples to s3: `s3://redwood-smoke/tidepool/fails/7870012377.jsonl`. If infra run still shows tail cases we can ship a tiny adapter patch with a token-remap layer.
Alex S: also add those failing items to the evaluation suite and wire a regression alert (daily) for EM drop >0.05 on numeric-amount subset.
Mira K: on it - will post infra-bot results and attach a sample of 10 failing cases once run completes. :thumbsup:
